plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-15 from the official University of Washington Bothell degree-map PDF 'B-Mechanical-Engineering-Degree-Map-2022.pdf' (printed footer 'Last updated: 09/22/2022'), hosted on uwb.edu. The map's title block prints only 'Mechanical Engineering'; the degree is confirmed by the source document's own title ('Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering'). Filed under catalog_year 2022-2023: this is an ARCHIVED map, not the current catalog. The current UW Bothell catalog is 2026-2027, and the degree maps the site currently links to are UW NetID SharePoint Word documents and MyPlan, both login-walled; no login was attempted, so the public 2022 PDF is the newest publicly verifiable official term-by-term map for this program. The map calls itself 'a suggested schedule of courses based on degree requirements' and 'not a substitute for academic advising' (printed on the map). UW Bothell is a quarter-system school; the 12 blocks below are the map's 12 quarters (Autumn/Winter/Spring, Years 1-4) in printed order. The map prints no per-term totals and no degree total. TOTAL AS PRINTED: applying the map's own printed credit rule (5 credits unless a parenthetical number is printed) to every printed cell, this plan sums to 196 credits, NOT 180: Years 1 and 2 sum to 45 each; Year 3 sums to 50 because each Year 3 quarter prints FOUR rows (18/14/18); Year 4 sums to 56 because each Year 4 quarter prints FIVE rows (Autumn's and Spring's fifth rows are blank as printed and carry no course; Autumn 14, Winter 23, Spring 19). The over-180 total is transcribed as printed and disclosed here, never smoothed. Two printed features inflate the total and are disclosed, not corrected: (1) B ME 410 Electrical Power & Machinery prints in BOTH Autumn and Winter of Year 4 — the Winter cell is annotated '(For students who did not take in AUT)', i.e. the two cells are alternate placements of the same course, but both are counted here because both are printed; the Winter occurrence is recorded as a choice slot with a synthetic code so the plan carries no duplicate course code. (2) The Year 3 Spring choice slot 'B ENGR 321 or STMATH 390' names two courses that also print earlier in the map (B ENGR 321 in Year 3 Autumn, STMATH 390 in Year 3 Winter); it is recorded as printed, as a choice slot with a synthetic code. Parenthetical credit exceptions recorded exactly: B ME 331 (4); B ENGR 320 (4); B ME 301 (1); B ME 332 (4); B ME 341 (4); B ME 333 (4); B ME 342 (4); B ME 343 (4); B ME 334 (2); B ENGR 494 (3); B ME 495 (3); B ME 496 (4). Non-credit parentheticals transcribed on the titles/notes, never read as credits: B ENGR 321 and STMATH 390 carry '(Can take A, W, or Sp)'; B ME 410's Autumn cell carries '(only half the cohort can take)'. B ENGR 310 (Year 3 Spring) and B ENGR 320 (Year 3 Autumn) both print the title 'Computational Physical Modeling' — transcribed as printed for both codes. The combined 'B CHEM 143 + 144' cell is folded into one entry under the lecture code; this map prints no parenthetical on that cell. Markers are disclosed, not recorded as prerequisites (the map prints no course-to-course prerequisite chain, so no prereqs are recorded): the diamond means 'Prerequisite: Must be completed prior to applying for a major'; the four-point marker means 'May be fulfilled with Discovery Core'; this map prints no checkmark or star legend. Competitive-applicant guidance printed on the map (prerequisite GPA 3.5, cumulative GPA 3.5, positive grade trend) is disclosed here and not encoded. Per-year printed notes: Year 2 — 'All prerequisites (yellow) should all be complete by the end of the second year at the very latest to stay on track for a four year degree program.' Year 3 — 'Mechanical Engineering is a cohort-based program, and the upper division coursework must be completed in the order prescribed.'
